paragraphs: Securus Technologies describes itself on its about page as a provider of communication services connecting family and friends to the incarcerated. The homepage describes Securus Video Connect as a web-based visual communication system for scheduling video sessions with an incarcerated individual. Other services named there include Securus eMessaging for messages, photos and video clips, and a Securus Debit account that funds phone calls, tablet subscriptions and games.

The about page says the company is headquartered in Dallas, Texas, and serves more than 3,400 public safety, law enforcement and corrections agencies. The same page puts the incarcerated population reached at over 1.2 million across North America.
Consumer pages point at people outside the facility, who open prepaid accounts and receive calls.

quote.text: Securus Technologies is headquartered in Dallas, Texas, and serves more than 3,400 public safety, law enforcement and corrections agencies and over 1.2 million incarcerated individuals across North America.
